column1: to provide for, the establishment of the Petroleum Development Authority
of Sri Lanka; the formulation of a National Policy on Upstream Petroleum
Industry and regulation and management structure capturing the maximum
economic  value  of  Domestic  Petroleum  Resources  through  modern
exploration, development, production and management practices in Sri
Lanka;  to  repeal  the  Petroleum  Resources  Act,  No.  26  of  2003;  and  to
provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto
